passages.title: Expense system rollout · Document 1
passages.text: Expense claims will move to FinanceTrack next month. Employees may attend a training session {{1}} this week. The system lets users {{2}} a claim from submission to payment. Upload all receipts {{3}} sending the claim for approval. Incomplete supporting documents may delay processing. {{4}}

passages.title: Banking maintenance · Document 1
passages.text: Online banking will be unavailable from midnight until 3 A.M. on Sunday while updates are {{1}}. Complete urgent transactions {{2}} the maintenance begins. Please do not submit the same payment repeatedly {{3}} you receive a confirmed failure message. Pending requests will be reconciled after service resumes. {{4}}

passages.title: Question Ocean · P6-G28 · Document 1
passages.text:
INTERNAL NOTICE

Last quarter, the records team tested automatic deletion for files that had reached the end of their retention period. The pilot reduced storage costs, but one folder subject to a legal hold was mistakenly placed in the deletion queue. {{1}} Accordingly, automatic deletion will remain disabled while the team adds a second verification step.

During the next trial, the system will generate a review list rather than delete files immediately. {{2}} Department managers will have two business days to report any exception. To make those reviews more {{3}}, each entry will display the policy that determines its proposed deletion date. If the next trial produces no unresolved exceptions, a broader launch {{4}} for October.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P6-G37 · Document 1
passages.text:
REUSABLE SHIPPING CONTAINER NOTICE

Beginning September 1, selected orders will arrive in reusable insulated containers. After unpacking an order, customers should remove the delivery label and place the empty container in the building lobby. Containers must be {{1}} within seven days so that they can be cleaned and used again. {{2}}, a replacement fee may be added to the customer's next invoice. {{3}} Customers can scan the code on the container to see the next scheduled collection time. Questions about a missed pickup should be reported {{4}} through the support portal.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R11 · Document 1
passages.text:
To: Regional Store Managers
From: Elaine Ford, Operations Director
Subject: Revised Return Procedure

Effective immediately, refunds for purchases over $300 require approval from a regional manager. Store employees should continue to process exchanges according to the existing policy. A revised return form has been uploaded to the company intranet. Please destroy any unused copies of the previous form by Friday.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R45 · Document 1
passages.text:
Announcement

Linton Manufacturing will test smart factory monitoring software on Line 4 from September 3 to September 30. The software collects machine-temperature data and sends alerts when equipment may require maintenance. During the trial, operators should continue using the existing inspection checklist. A feedback meeting will be held on October 2 to decide whether the system should be expanded to other production lines.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R30 · Document 1
passages.text: Westbridge Logistics has opened a temperature-controlled warehouse near the Port of Kaohsiung. The facility is designed for food and medical products that require stable storage conditions. It includes real-time monitoring systems and backup power generators. According to the company, the warehouse will reduce delivery time for customers in southern Taiwan.

passages.title: Interview room booking · Document 1
passages.text:
ROOM BOOKING UPDATE
Interview rooms can be reserved in blocks of up to ninety minutes. The final ten minutes of each block are for clearing the room and resetting equipment, so they should not be counted as interview time. Longer assessments require two linked blocks approved by recruitment. Please remove candidate notes when leaving; the next booking may be for a different department. A room reservation does not include an interviewer or technical support.

passages.title: Staff bicycle loans · Document 1
passages.text:
BICYCLE LOAN SCHEME
Staff can borrow a company bicycle for approved local business trips. The booking includes a lock and helmet, which must be returned with the bicycle. Loans for commuting are available under a separate pilot and require an additional agreement. Before departure, report any visible fault to facilities; a confirmed booking does not establish that a bicycle is roadworthy. If in doubt, use another travel option until the bicycle is checked.

passages.title: External-speaker access · Document 1
passages.text:
SPEAKER INFORMATION
Guest speakers should send presentation files by Wednesday for a compatibility check. This check confirms that files open on our equipment; it does not approve their factual claims or grant permission to use third-party images. Speakers remain responsible for those matters. A live demonstration using an external service should include an offline fallback, since venue internet access is shared. Tell the coordinator if your demonstration needs a restricted network setting.

passages.title: Travel workshop funding · Document 1
passages.text:
PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
This fund pays approved course fees up to 400 dollars. Travel and accommodation are considered separately and are not automatically approved when the course is accepted. Staff must provide the course outline and explain its relevance to their work before booking. An attendance receipt alone is insufficient for reimbursement if prior approval was required but not obtained. Questions about exceptions should be raised with the development coordinator, not the course provider.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R05 · Document 1
passages.text: The Green Workplace Committee invites employees to join a lunchtime workshop on reducing office waste. The workshop will be held in Room 402 on October 6 from 12:15 to 1:00 P.M. Participants will learn how to set up paper-reduction goals and organize reusable supply stations. A light lunch will be provided. Because seating is limited to 35 people, employees should register through the internal portal by October 2.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R81 · Document 1
passages.text:
Staff Notice

Beginning March 4, all employees who reserve shared workstations must confirm their bookings by 8:30 A.M. on the day of use. Workstations that are not confirmed by that time will be released to employees on the waiting list. This policy was introduced after several departments reported that desks remained unused even though they had been reserved. Employees who often travel to client sites may still reserve desks up to two weeks in advance, but they should cancel unnecessary bookings as early as possible.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R90 · Document 1
passages.text:
COMMUNITY INNOVATION HUB — DISPLAY BOARD POLICY

Local nonprofit groups may use the lobby display board at no charge for up to three weeks. Commercial advertisements and notices promoting political candidates are not accepted. [1]

Notices must be printed on A4 paper, show the first and last display dates, and receive staff approval before posting. [2] Materials that are handwritten or larger than the permitted size will be returned. [3]

Bring the final printed notice to the reception desk between 9 A.M. and 5 P.M. Staff will send an approval decision by e-mail within two business days. [4] Approved notices will be posted by a hub employee.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R73 · Document 1
passages.text:
BUILDING NOTICE

Greenline Tower will test emergency power on September 12 from 7 to 9 A.M. Elevators will operate one at a time, and tenants are asked to postpone nonessential deliveries until after 9:30. The loading dock will remain open for urgent medical and food shipments.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R73 · Document 2
passages.text:
E-MAIL
From: Lena Cho, Brightwell Events
To: Setup Crew
Subject: September 12 Delivery

Our stage equipment is scheduled to arrive at Greenline Tower at 8 A.M. on September 12. The cases are heavy and require two elevator trips. Since the client rehearsal does not begin until 1 P.M., I have asked the carrier to move delivery to 10 A.M. Please update the setup crew's arrival from 8:30 to 10:30.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R67 · Document 1
passages.text:
Product Page

The NomaDesk Flex Chair includes adjustable armrests, a breathable back panel, and a five-year frame warranty. Assembly usually takes twenty minutes and requires no tools. Bulk orders of ten or more chairs qualify for free delivery.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R67 · Document 2
passages.text:
Customer Review

The chair is comfortable, and assembly was easy. However, our office ordered twelve chairs in gray, and two arrived in blue. Customer service responded quickly and said replacements would ship after they verified the original order.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R67 · Document 3
passages.text:
Return Policy

Color errors must be reported within seven days of delivery. Customers should provide the order number and a photograph of the item received. Replacement items are shipped without additional delivery charges once the error is confirmed.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R38 · Document 1
passages.text:
E-MAIL
From: Alan Becker
To: Nina Tan, Apex Signs
Subject: Lobby Sign

Ms. Tan,
The illuminated sign delivered yesterday has a small crack on the lower right corner. Our office opening is scheduled for next Friday, so we need to know whether a replacement can arrive before then. Please also confirm whether your team will remove the damaged sign from our lobby.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R38 · Document 2
passages.text:
REPLY
From: Nina Tan
To: Alan Becker
Subject: RE: Lobby Sign

Mr. Becker,
I apologize for the damage. A replacement sign can be delivered on Wednesday morning, and our installers will take away the damaged unit at no charge. Because the replacement is covered under the shipping warranty, you will not receive an additional invoice.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R46 · Document 1
passages.text:
E-MAIL
From: Jordan Lee, Workplace Technology
To: Harbor Point Staff
Subject: Digital Badge Pilot

From July 8 to July 22, employees in the Facilities and Visitor Services teams will test a digital badge stored in the company mobile app. The badge can unlock the west entrance and check in guests at the reception kiosk. Employees should keep their physical badge during the trial. Feedback forms must be submitted by July 25.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R46 · Document 2
passages.text:
PROJECT UPDATE
The pilot will be expanded company-wide only if the app works reliably on older phones. A low-power setting is scheduled for release before the next phase. Contractors are not included in the pilot because temporary physical badges are still required for their access records.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R46 · Document 3
passages.text:
CHAT MESSAGE
Lina: I tested the digital badge yesterday. It opened the west entrance, but my phone battery dropped faster than usual.
Jordan: Thanks. The low-power setting should address that. Please note it in your feedback form.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R108 · Document 1
passages.text:
DOCUMENT 1 - SMART ACCESS PILOT

From August 5 through August 30, employees on floors 8-12 may use a mobile access pass instead of a plastic badge. To join the pilot, install the SecureEntry app and complete identity verification before August 2. The mobile pass works at office entrances and shared meeting rooms, but it cannot be used for the parking garage. Participants should keep their plastic badge during the pilot. A help desk will operate in the main lobby from 8:00 to 10:00 A.M. on August 5 and 6.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R108 · Document 2
passages.text:
DOCUMENT 2 - MESSAGE

From: Priya
To: Facilities Support
Date: August 7

The mobile pass opens the tenth-floor office door, but the reader outside Conference Room 10 B displays "pass not recognized." I have a client presentation there at 11:00 tomorrow. I will be working from home this afternoon, so I cannot visit the lobby help desk today. Is there another way to have the room access checked?
